product_one_liner.value: Sona is an AI-powered workforce management platform for large frontline organisations, helping operators manage scheduling, forecasting, HR, payroll and workforce decisions across multiple locations.
product_one_liner.notes: The company homepage describes the platform as improving workforce decisions across locations and serves large frontline organisations.

pricing_page.notes: The page offers tailored pricing and directs prospective customers to book a consultation or request a quote, so a public pricing page exists even though it does not publish fixed prices.

named_customers.notes: The customer stories page lists these customers and links to their case studies.

employee_band.notes: LinkedIn's company profile lists 255 employees, which falls in the 201-500 band.

hq_location.notes: The company's LinkedIn profile identifies London, England, United Kingdom as its headquarters.

founded_year.notes: Sona's About page states it was founded in 2021.

eng_blog.notes: The blog index is focused on industry insights, product announcements, customer stories, partnerships and marketing; it does not show at least two engineering-authored posts about product architecture, infrastructure, ML implementation, data or open source.

public_docs.notes: The homepage navigation/footer provides no product documentation, help-centre or developer-portal link; the homepage provides no indication of a multi-article public docs site.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The current jobs listing includes a Labour AI Specialist role; its title contains AI, meeting the question's title-based criteria.

model_provider.notes: Checked the product blog, privacy policy and Trust Centre. The publicly available materials reviewed do not identify which AI model or model provider Sona uses.

compliance_certs.notes: Sona has a Trust Centre, but the public material reviewed there did not name SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA, GDPR or PCI DSS as certifications.

last_funding.notes: The April 1, 2026 funding announcement reports a $45 million Series B.

raised_18mo.notes: The Series B announced in April 2026 falls within the 18 months before November 9, 2026.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The live job listings include account-executive and BDR roles.

launched_6mo.notes: The readable company blog history shows dated launch-type items before May 9, 2026; its February 12, 2026 Grateful post announces an integration partnership, not a new product or major feature. No product or major-feature launch dated May 9-November 9, 2026 was found in the readable blog history.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: The About page identifies founders but does not provide a complete, checkable leadership roster. A February 2026 post announced a CIO Advisor, but that title is advisory rather than a C-level or VP-level appointment; no qualifying C-level/VP change could be verified.

crm_stack_signal.notes: Sona's integrations directory explicitly names Found CRM. Other listed connections are not identified there as CRM or sales-and-marketing systems.
